cues: Interviews go deep but are slow.
Observation shows what people really do.
And prototypes let users react to a screen, which they are much better at than describing what they want.
The results go into the SRS, where every requirement must be testable: the system should be fast is useless; a receipt shall print within five seconds can be checked.
text: How are requirements collected? Interviews go deep but are slow. Questionnaires reach many people cheaply. Observation shows what people really do. Documents show the real data. And prototypes let users react to a screen, which they are much better at than describing what they want. The results go into the SRS, where every requirement must be testable: the system should be fast is useless; a receipt shall print within five seconds can be checked.
